decision.title: Packet 1.23b: more library functions, lexical base URI, charged steps
decision.summary: Packet 1.23b adds 62 library functions (math, QName and namespace, node, string, URI, sequence, context), writes annotation types in adaptive output, makes the static base URI lexical, and charges leaf steps.

item.p: Functions added (62): the math namespace (src/function_library_math.c, part sxml_function_library_math: pi, e, exp, exp10, log, log10, pow, sqrt, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, atan2, sinh, cosh, tanh, as the C17 Annex F functions; pow with an integer exponent is pown, sign by parity beyond 2^53); QNames and namespaces (src/function_library_qname.c, part sxml_function_library_qname: local-name-, prefix-, namespace-uri-from-QName, expanded-QName, in-scope-prefixes, in-scope-namespaces, namespace-uri-for-prefix); node: doc-available (loads through the document loader, FODC errors mean false), base-uri, document-uri, has-children, generate-id (t<tree>n<index>[s<ns>]; JNodes UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE); string: translate, codepoint-equal, contains-token, substring-before-last, substring-after-last, trim-space, parse-integer (int64, then exact decimals); uri: encode-for-uri, iri-to-uri, escape-html-uri; sequence: identity, unordered, void, foot, trunk, slice, items-at, replicate, insert-separator, compare, atomic-equal, all-equal, all-different, duplicate-values, default-collation; context: dateTime and the six *-from-duration functions. The processor and the fuzz fixture name the two new parts. Gaps (77 functions with their own XP40 test sets, 4,165 test cases) are listed in the 1.23b line of the task file; fn:normalize-unicode needs the Unicode decomposition tables and is one.

Adaptive output (src/serialize.c): the constructor-function form writes the name of the item's type annotation, not of its primitive type (xs:dateTimeStamp(...), xs:dayTimeDuration(...)), as qtspecs PR 2981 revises Serialization 4.0 and QT4 Serialization-adaptive-37a expects. The other rules still go by "instance of" (derived strings quoted, derived integers as numbers), which every XQ40 adaptive test accepts; -41 and -42 (XQ31+) still expect xs:duration and fail.

The static base URI is lexical (XPath 4.0, section 2.2.1): IR units carry it (sxml_ir_unit_set_static_base_uri, set by lowering from sxml_xpath_static_context.static_base_uri), and sxml_dynamic_context_get_static_base_uri answers that of the unit of the innermost task that runs IR, falling back to the evaluation request's for units that never set one. A function item called after its evaluation, or by another expression, sees its own (replaces the last bullet of 's "Static base URI"). The document loader no longer falls back to the evaluation's static base URI: callers pass it.

Charged steps (completes ): sxml_function_library_charge_steps and _charge_items (no-ops without a dynamic context) charge leaf work: one step per item for fn:string-join, fn:distinct-values, fn:duplicate-values, fn:contains-token, fn:items-at, fn:replicate, fn:insert-separator and fn:count of a lazy sequence or concatenation; n log2 n for fn:sort; one per pair for fn:deep-equal; the regex instructions each search ran (new sxml_regex_matcher_get_step_count) for fn:matches, fn:replace and fn:tokenize; |value| x |replace| for fn:translate.
